answer: The ember index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the umber queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 919 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the crystal. Bonded capital sits idle for 3 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
